sections.notes: A river-and-flowage trip with a mandatory land carry around Amery Dam. Start at the Birch Street access area and finish at the Black Brook Flowage landing, upstream of Black Brook Dam. Both markers are approximate access areas. The 5.7-mile planning distance is preliminary; inspect the landings and signed carry before launching.
sections.routeReview: Amery documents a marked canoe/kayak portage east of its dam. The carry and exact shoreline connections are not mapped; no continuous dotted path through the dam is approved.

notices.title: Amery Dam: portage required
notices.text: Use the city’s marked canoe/kayak carry east of Amery Dam. Locate the take-out dock and signed route before approaching the barrier. This trip ends at Black Brook Flowage access, above the separate Black Brook Dam. Confirm current access and carry conditions before launching.
notices.sourceName: City of Amery — canoeing and kayaking
